items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the higher direct images of a quasi-coherent module along an affine morphism of algebraic spaces vanish in positive degrees (statement lines 1521-1527). The proof recalls that such a morphism is representable, which reduces the question to the corresponding statement for affine morphisms of schemes via the general theory of higher direct images for representable morphisms. The reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
